title: Data-Driven Identification of Uncertainty Sets with Conformance Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2611.31127v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Formal verification and controller synthesis require accurate models. Conformance relations specify the required accuracy of a model such that properties established for the model carry over to the target system. Existing methods for establishing them from measured data are typically restricted to a single relation, a specific model class, or a downstream verification algorithm. We present ConfID, a unified framework that establishes reachset, trace, and simulation conformance with respect to measured traces by identifying uncertainty sets for a given, possibly nonlinear nominal model. Unmodeled effects are thus captured by nondeterminism rather than by refining the nominal dynamics. For all three conformance relations, the identification is a linear program that minimizes the size of the reachable sets; only its constraints depend on the relation. We further derive distribution-free bounds on the probability that the identified models

translated_title: 具有一致性保证的不确定性集合数据驱动辨识
translated_abstract: 形式化验证与控制器综合需要精确的模型。一致性关系规定了模型所需达到的精度，使得针对模型建立的属性能够传递到目标系统。现有的从测量数据建立一致性的方法通常局限于单一的一致性关系、特定的模型类别或特定的下游验证算法。我们提出了ConfID——一个统一框架，通过为给定的、可能是非线性的标称模型辨识不确定性集合，基于测量轨迹建立可达集一致性、轨迹一致性和仿真一致性。由此，未建模的效应通过非确定性来刻画，而无需细化标称动力学。对于全部三种一致性关系，辨识均可表述为一个最小化可达集大小的线性规划，仅其约束条件依赖于所选的一致性关系。我们进一步推导了所辨识模型概率的无分布界……
tldr: 提出统一框架ConfID，通过线性规划为可能非线性的标称模型辨识不确定性集合，同时建立可达集、轨迹与仿真三种一致性保证，使验证结论能从模型可靠地传递到真实系统。
en_tdlr: ConfID is a unified framework that identifies uncertainty sets for possibly nonlinear nominal models via linear programs, establishing reachset, trace, and simulation conformance so that verified properties carry over to the real system.
